facts.fact: A national workshop at Ebolowa on 3-14 November 2025, under the World Bank-supported PATNUC project, gave technical validation to the draft law (avant-projet) on access to public information and digital transformation of the administration, now ready for ministerial and institutional finalisation; the report was published 21 January 2026.
